reason: The hypothesis combines two separate single-layer laser cladding strategies from different papers—an in situ Si/Ti5Si3 bonding layer (P2, P10) and a Ni60-B4C-CeO2 wear-resistant top layer (P8, P27)—into a new dual-layer architecture with a stated rationale of graded transition and stress minimization, which no single passage proposes or studies.
copied_elements: in situ Si-reinforced layer forming Ti5Si3 on TC4 (P2, P10, P17)
Ni60-based top layer with B4C and CeO2 (P8, P27)
metallurgical bonding from laser cladding (P5, P35)
grain refinement and porosity reduction by CeO2 (P8)
hard phases TiC, TiB improving wear resistance (P8, P24)
